{{Top|leg}}
The '''collimator beam focuser''' was a tool used to maintain and repair a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapon. It was a probe-like device which was inserted along the weapon's barrel to realign the [[Prismatic crystal/Legends|prismatic crystal]] housing and also to calibrate the [[static pulse adaptor]]s. A collimator beam focuser was included in [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech's]] [[Blaster Repair Kit]].
